currency_notes: CNYKRW=X returned no observations; CNY uses two observed USD legs. FX forward fill is causal, never backfilled; trade requires FX age <= 5 calendar days.
price_basis: Yahoo Close, auto_adjust=False: splits reflected, dividends excluded; KRW conversion

corporate_action_aliases.reason: Issuer-confirmed ticker rename of the same security; Yahoo ECHO includes prior history

backfill_temporal_limitation: The source snapshots were retrieved retrospectively, mainly 2026-09-27. as_of_date is a disclosure label, not an archived publication timestamp. Execution must impose a disclosure delay; historical point-in-time availability is not proven.
calendar_and_execution_limitation: Local close dates from several time zones share a date axis. Same-date foreign stock and FX closes are daily marks, not synchronized executable quotes. Use strict following-date local execution, slippage/costs and extra lag sensitivity.
share_class_note: GOOG and GOOGL are combined at company level; GOOG is the execution proxy. Canonical quantity flows are calculated on each original share class before combination. SKHYV is canonicalized to SKHY, while Korean 000660 remains a distinct listing.
